Remark
[Uniform tail criterion] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0282 1. ch23:23.39\group Supplementary analysis

The uniform convergence hypothesis means that for every $\varepsilon >0$ there is an $R$ such that $\left|\int _{\mathcal M\setminus B(O,R)}f(x,t)\, d\mu \right|<\varepsilon $ for all $t\in [\alpha ,\omega ]$.
